title: 船舶鋼板曲面成形
summary: 從平板到雙曲率表面，分開幾何彎曲、熱伸長、回彈和量測基準的作用。 在船板曲面與光學量測室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Separate geometric bending, thermal expansion, springback and measurement datums when moving from plate to doubly curved form. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Curved ship-plate and optical metrology studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 板厚與主曲率應變：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Thickness and principal-curvature strain: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 板厚與主曲率應變 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Thickness and principal-curvature strain and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶鋼板曲面成形」的「板厚與主曲率應變」中，薄板彎曲外纖維應變可用厚度與中性面半徑估算。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：從平板到雙曲率表面，分開幾何彎曲、熱伸長、回彈和量測基準的作用。
steps.instructionEn: Within Curved ship-plate forming, Thickness and principal-curvature strain examines this mechanism: Outer-fiber bending strain can be estimated from thickness and neutral-surface radius. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Separate geometric bending, thermal expansion, springback and measurement datums when moving from plate to doubly curved form.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：板厚 t=0.006 m，R=2 m。關係式 ε≈t/(2R)；含單位換算算式 0.006/(2*2)*100 = 0.15 %。適用條件：小應變幾何估算，不含回彈、雙曲率塑性或成形配方。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Thickness 0.006 m and neutral-surface radius 2 m. Relation ε≈t/(2R); expression including unit conversion 0.006/(2*2)*100 = 0.15 %. Applicability: Small-strain geometry; excludes springback, double-curvature plasticity and forming recipes.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：忽略回彈會使模具輪廓與成品輪廓不同。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Ignoring springback causes tool and finished-part shapes to differ. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「板厚與主曲率應變」，沿兩個主曲率方向量測，勿把單曲率當完整曲面。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Thickness and principal-curvature strain, Measure both principal curvature directions; one curvature does not define a full surface. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「板厚與主曲率應變」比較基準算式 0.006/(2*2)*100 與替代算式 0.006/(2*1)*100。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 0.3 %，與基準 0.15 % 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。
knowledge.textEn: For Thickness and principal-curvature strain, compare baseline expression 0.006/(2*2)*100 with alternative 0.006/(2*1)*100. Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 0.3 %, versus baseline 0.15 %. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.
